attempts.summary: On node1 (Alpine Linux 3.23), created a local CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" (self-signed RSA-4096 cert, /etc/ssl/os-comparison-ca/{ca.key,ca.crt}), installed it into the system trust store via /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt + update-ca-certificates, and verified trust by validating a leaf certificate signed by this CA against the system bundle. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy trust-store state, rebooted node1 via sudo -n reboot, polled until exec was available again, confirmed the boot_id changed (31b36710... -> 251fea18...), and re-verified the CA and leaf-cert trust chain post-restart.
